name: Summer Stress Day
description: The canonical 140 MW story: a 4 PM–8 PM stress event removes spare capacity. The battery covers 40 MW and only 10 MW of AI training is paused. Inference is never touched.

beats.title: Normal operations
beats.text: Flexible jobs run on grid headroom. Firm load is always served.

beats.title: MISO Capacity Advisory
beats.text: The forecaster sees a stress window ahead. Sites pre-position: batteries charge to 100% and the deferral queue is built.

beats.title: Conservative Operations
beats.text: Flexible ramp-up is capped across the fleet.

beats.title: P10 headroom below flexible demand
beats.text: Hoosier Compute Campus: battery discharges 40 MW to hold the 50 MW of flexible work.

beats.title: Max Gen Alert
beats.text: 10 MW of AI training checkpoints and pauses. Inference is untouched and firm 90 MW holds.

beats.title: All clear
beats.text: Paused jobs resume. Batteries begin their overnight recharge.

callouts.text: P10 headroom falls below flexible demand at 16:05 — battery pre-charge 100%
Max Gen Alert active: 10 MW of training paused, inference untouched
